pr_title: jobs: handle retryable errors waiting for jobs
pr_body:
Previously, when waiting for jobs if the internal executor hit any retryable errors, we would incorrectly bubble these errors up. This would intermittently be seen in leasing tests, which intentionally disable renewals, increasing the likelihood of transaction retry errors. To address this, this patch will modify waitForJobs to handle retryable errors gracefully.

Fixes: #112392
fixes #110642
fixes #111166
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/112696
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/112180
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/112377

Release note: None

review_comments:
nice find! a few semi-related comments before we go with this:
- could you add a comment that mentions that this is safe to retry here because we use a new txn for each query?
- also i'm a bit surprised - the internal executor is supposed to retry this automatically. so it feels like something else must be going wrong if that isn't working. 
- could we avoid retry errors by making `makeWaitForJobsQuery` use a fixed timestamp?
- there should be a test that reproduces the problem reliably so we can make sure the fix works going forwards. this test would also help us understand why the internal executor did not retry.

> also i'm a bit surprised - the internal executor is supposed to retry this automatically. so it feels like something else must be going wrong if that isn't working.

@rafiss It's because results are returned to the client, so it's no longer safe to retry internally in this case. Let me double check and confirm that one more time too
